segments.title: Cold Open & Minnesota Drug Detection Story
segments.notes: Case opens the new year broadcast, discovers a developing sty, shows off Kendall's sister's metal cup gift, and covers Minnesota's voluntary oral fluid drug testing pilot for drivers with a memorable stock photo of an intense officer demonstrating the swab.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple: AI George Carlin Special Investigation
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple returns from a second holiday break to dissect the Dudesy podcast's AI-generated George Carlin hour 'I'm Glad I'm Dead,' debating whether the writing is actually AI or human-written with a voice filter, while Case administers a satirical q-tip drug test live on air.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: AI Comedy vs Human Comedy
segments.notes: Munch argues AI comedy is a 'soylent green of the mind' destroying human creative essence; Crum champions AI as harmless robot slaves doing jokes. Munch claims victory in a close poll, then declares himself an immortal wizard and merkin-wearer.

segments.title: The Jo Rogen Experience: Dual Rogans on Carlin, MIT Robots & DMT
segments.notes: Two Joe Rogans (and Jamie) discuss the Carlin AI special, Jamie's Discovery Zone rope-course build, MIT robots getting kicked, Shakespeare pentameter conspiracy theories, and a doctor's diagnosis of athlete's foot on Joe's butt cheek from kicking himself too hard.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Paramount Auction & Media Consolidation
segments.notes: Chet joins to discuss Paramount's reported auction to highest bidder (Warner Bros. Discovery, Skydance, investment firms), Shari Redstone's controlling stake, and the sad fate of Paramount+ as a 'little media god' with only Halo and South Park.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Film Friday Trailer Roundup
segments.notes: Trent (with parole officer Chet) reviews trailers for Money Plane (Edge, Brendan Fraser), Halo Season 2 (Master Chief close-ups), Alexander: The Making of a God, and The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live (Rick & Michonne, Borat-adjacent line).

segments.title: Trip on the Street: Council of Donalds & Street Interviews
segments.notes: Trip interviews Dr. Surgeon Rev Don Donald Jr. (Council of Donalds excommunicates Trump, makes Trip honorary Donald), Conway Trippy (music genre 'what is that music,' happy trail signing request), Cruiser Sign Bars (swabbing holes for Minnesota tests), Bennett McHorse (Messy Tuna Extravaganza date), Jasper (goo law-abiding citizen), and Dr. What (Who's on First routine).

segments.title: Closing & Raid to Be Vilgic
segments.notes: Case dons Trip Bradstein memorial wig, raids Be Vilgic's Party Animals stream after considering Jim Tasty, promotes Monday Cream Team podcast, and signs off with eye health concerns.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News rings in the new year with Case Blackwell's developing sty, a Minnesota oral-swab drug testing pilot featuring an unforgettable stock-photo officer, and Jeff Ripple's deep dive into the Dudesy podcast's AI George Carlin special. The Munch & Crum debate erupts over AI comedy's threat to human creativity, followed by a dual-Joe-Rogan experience covering MIT robots, Shakespeare conspiracies, and butt-cheek athlete's foot. Chet breaks down Paramount's looming auction, Trent reviews B-movie trailers with parole-officer Chet in tow, and Trip Bradstein convenes the Council of Donalds on the streets before Case raids Be Vilgic in a Trip memorial wig.
